description: This Java interface defines a contract for resolving a field of a referenced entity within the context of placeholder resolution in the Ditto services framework.

classes.name: ReferencePlaceholderResolver
classes.description: A generic interface for resolving a specific field of a referenced entity, returning a CompletionStage of the type T.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the given ReferencePlaceholder using provided DittoHeaders, returning a CompletionStage of type T.
